title: 5.31 读者感谢
slug: 电锯人开局契约斩杀线恶魔
content_zh:
感谢读者南方梭巡的二十三张月票，

零时的零食的十七张月票，

舰桥大学的舰长的五张月票，

破绽陈的四张月票，

别团等我召唤神龙的三张月票，

书友20210825183706937的两张月票，

以及不正常的正常人、书友20240830125640387、乐道人的各一张月票！

你们的每一张票都是对我最大的鼓励，感谢大家！

更多推荐票支持的朋友由于人数太多就不一一道名了，但是还是感谢你们的支持！

谢谢喵，谢谢支持喵。

PS：考虑到工作量问题，从下个月开始。每隔15天会单独发月票感谢章。

此外，截止当天发感谢章前一天为止，位居于月票金主榜位的读者，可以单独将你的头像发在评论区，我会特地为你制作一张图片用于感谢。（例如15号发的感谢章，14号就可以发出。如果本人不希望这么做可以不发。）

《电锯人，开局契约斩杀线恶魔》5.31 读者感谢 正在手打中，请稍等片刻，

内容更新后，请重新刷新页面，即可获取最新更新！
content_en:
Thanks to readers Nanfangxun for their twenty-three monthly passes,

Seventeen monthly passes for snacks at odd hours,

Five monthly passes for the captain of the Bridge University,

Flaw Chen’s four monthly passes,

The other group is waiting for my three monthly tickets to summon the dragon.

Two monthly passes from book friend 20210825183706937,

And a monthly pass each for abnormal normal people, book friends 20240830125640387, and music lovers!

Every vote you give is the greatest encouragement to me, thank you all!

Since there are too many friends who have recommended more votes, I will not name them one by one, but thank you for your support!

Thank you, meow. Thank you for supporting meow.

PS: Considering the workload issue, it will start from next month.Monthly vote thank you stamps will be issued separately every 15 days.

In addition, as of the day before the thank you stamp is issued on the day, readers who are among the top monthly ticket financiers can post your avatar in the comment area alone, and I will specially create a picture for you to express gratitude.(For example, the thank you stamp issued on the 15th can be issued on the 14th. If I don’t want to do this, I don’t have to issue it.)

"Chainsaw Man, Begin the Contract to Kill the Line Demon" 5.31 Thanks to the readers. It is being played, please wait a moment.

After the content is updated, please refresh the page to get the latest updates!
